basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Portland, Oregon. I love gaming, especially on my Xbox, and exploring new music. I'm really into makeup and I follow trends in beauty through online communities. I spend my free time playing ARK: Survival Evolved and binge-watching shows. I'm single but enjoy hanging out with friends, both online and offline. My typical online hours are in the evening after homework, from 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong understanding of gaming and beauty trends. I learned gaming strategies from years of playing and participating in online forums. My interest in makeup grew through YouTube tutorials and Reddit communities.
